profiles.rationale: The retained source/bytecode constructs fresh leaf and internal Node objects and recursively checks both children. Independent identity witnesses inspect ten disjoint graphs and preserve 511 descendants through natural G1 collection with only their root strongly held. The actual depth-21 single-entry instruction review covers every installed tree/check/main version, surviving allocation sequences, OSR root transfer and OopMaps through the final check. Both main OSR versions actually entered; no installed Node elimination or C2 normal-entry main is asserted.

The source/bytecode rotates each factoradic permutation, copies its array before prefix flips, adds the rank-parity checksum and updates the maximum. Independent five-permutation witnesses compare flip counts and unchanged original arrays. Required rotate/flips/main JIT records, 10,000 checked main outputs and bounded size coverage retain the full permutation work.

The retained code generates the complete ALU repeat and both weighted random sequences, uses all 15 IUB and four human probabilities, advances the specified 3877/29573/139968 LCG for each random base and retains the seed across both sequences. It emits 2n/3n/5n lengths with 60-column wrapping. Source/bytecode ownership, required JIT targets, bounded outputs and 10,000 checked main outputs bind that work.

The retained table method allocates a fresh HashMap and visits every overlapping window; main materializes all seven lengths 1,2,3,4,6,12,18 before output. Independent witnesses compare every map entry and total for seven sequences, retain seven distinct maps simultaneously, and verify an eighth fresh table does not mutate earlier maps. Frequency ties use ascending ASCII keys. Required JIT records and 10,000 checked mains are retained; full-input heap feasibility is not claimed.

Source and retained bytecode traverse every row and column, perform the bounded 50-step binary64 recurrence and bailout, and pack PBM bits most-significant first with zero odd-width padding. Required recurrence/main JIT records, exact bounded PBM outputs and 10,000 checked main outputs retain this work.

Five fresh bodies receive momentum offset in all three axes; each requested step updates both velocities for all ten pairs and advances every position. Initial and final energy both include every kinetic term and pair potential. Source/bytecode, required JIT methods and checked nine-decimal output bind those loops to the retained class and runtime.

The actual single-entry main is interpreted: the complete closed HotSpot compiler log has no queued, completed, installed or inline main reference. Retained loaded MainKt bytecode has two general BigInteger.divide calls at BCI122 and BCI201 before the comparison at BCI216; both dominate it, with all loop backedges returning to BCI48 and no exception handlers. All naturally installed targeted division implementations are captured. This establishes the required execution path, not a numeric dynamic division-call count.

The retained implementation decodes bytes as Latin1, applies the prescribed header/newline cleanup, counts all nine case-sensitive expressions, and executes all five replacements sequentially with complete prefix/match/suffix copying before reporting all three lengths. The loaded regex implementation is the retained JDK platform dependency. Source/bytecode, required JIT targets, boundary fixtures and 10,000 checked outputs bind the complete work.

The retained source/bytecode scans every FASTA record, preserves headers, handles comments/line endings through the counted helper, traverses every sequence in reverse, maps the full IUPAC alphabet and emits 60-column wrapping. Required JIT targets and the original plus supplemental record/IUPAC/line-ending outputs bind the actual implementation. No helper or native-library source is silently omitted from the authored-source boundary.

Double arrays retain all u/v/work values. Both matrix-vector directions visit every coefficient with the proper transposed index, the driver performs all ten repeated two-Ata iterations, and full uv/vv dot products feed the final square root. Source/bytecode, required coefficient/multiplication/main JIT records and checked outputs preserve these operations.
